The Approximate Number Generation chart has three slices: Comparative Relationships (36.26%, blue), Absolute Absence (18.71%, purple), and Approximate Quantities (45.03%, yellow). The Disjunctive & Conjunctive chart is split into two slices: Disjunctive (49.51%, purple) and Conjunctive (50.49%, pink). All charts display percentage labels inside each slice. The slices in each chart are arranged in no particular order, and there is no legend or visual emphasis on any slice.
